label: A little introduction
heading: Well, hello there.
photo_alt: Portrait of Zainab in a white hijab against an olive-gold wall, glancing toward the camera
subheading: I’m Zainab, but you can call me Zay.
text:
I’m a writer, photographer and creative entrepreneur who loves helping people bring their ideas to life.

I believe beauty exists in the most unexpected places, sometimes just waiting to be noticed.

This is where my words, photographs and creative experiments meet. It’s also home to Zay & Form, where ideas take shape through creative strategy, storytelling and thoughtful visual communication.

I’m glad you’re here. Have a look around.
